meta_title: White-Label VPN: Run Your Own VPN Brand | VpnHood!
meta_description: Launch your own VPN brand with your own app and your own prices, on a VPN built to beat censorship. We run the servers, so you can focus on selling.
page_desc: Your own VPN under your own name: your app, your prices, your customers. We run the servers and everything behind them, so you can focus on selling.
hero_alt: A phone with a blank app icon and an empty name plate, a price tag on its corner and three colour swatches
diagram_title: Every sale ends up in your store
diagram_desc: Your customers buy on your website and, if you add in-app purchases, on Google Play and the App Store. Every sale lands in your store, which gets a premium code from VpnHood!, invisible to your customer. Your app signs in to your store and receives the code.
diagram_caption: your customers only ever see your brand
need_desc: That is all it takes. White-label is VpnHood! PARTNER plus your own app, and in-app purchases are an option you can add.
need_store_desc: White-label is built on VpnHood! PARTNER, so your store comes first. It takes every order and gets the premium code from us automatically.
need_app_desc: Your name, logo and icon on Android, iOS, Windows and Linux. Your customers sign in from the app, and their premium code arrives on its own.
need_iap_desc: Customers can also buy inside your app. Google or Apple pays you, less its commission, and each purchase becomes a normal order in your store.
publish_title: Let us publish your app, or do it yourself
publish_desc: Either way the app is yours, on your own Google Play and Apple developer accounts, because the stores pay only the account that publishes an app.
publish_us_desc: You need no mobile developers. You open the store accounts and press Submit when a release is ready, and we do the rest: the branding, the builds, the store listings and the updates. This is a separate service, so contact us for pricing.
publish_you_desc: If you have developers of your own, they can build and publish the app themselves. The engine is open source. Talk to us first and we will show them where to start.
start_title: Start selling first, then add your app
start_s1_desc: Tell us about your plans and we open your account. Install VpnHood! PARTNER and you can start selling premium codes for VpnHood! CONNECT.
start_s2_desc: Your store keeps selling while your app is built and reviewed by Google and Apple.
start_s3_desc: Your app goes live under your name. Your customers, your codes and your credit carry over.
cta: Thinking about a brand of your own? Tell us what you have in mind.
